text: Welcome, driver. I'm George. Here is how to install the Fetch Gen San Driver app, set your own rates, and finish your first trip.
On Android, open Chrome and go to genestjanramirez dot com slash fetch slash driver. Tap the menu, then Install app. Or install the driver A P K from the description.
On iPhone, open Safari, go to the same address, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Allow location and camera when asked.
Now let's use it. Just follow the green circles.
Step 1. Log in to the driver app with your email.
Step 2. Your real name, mobile number and a valid ID with a selfie.
Step 3. Add your real vehicle and plate number. Customers choose by these.
Step 4. Set your own rates: flag-down, per kilometres, per minute and minimum fare.
Add your G Cash number so customers can pay you directly.
Tap Go online to start receiving bookings.
We will send you a test booking.
A new request! See the route, fare, payment method and distance to pick-up.
Not happy with the price? Send a counter offer. Otherwise tap Accept.
Call or chat with your customer. Tap Navigate to open Google Maps.
Your location is shared live with the customer while you drive.
At the pick-up, tap I have arrived.
When the customer is on board, start the trip. The meter runs automatically.
At the destination, tap Complete trip.
The customer pays and rates you. Check the G Cash reference, then tap Payment received.
Rate your customer too.
Earnings shows today's income, tips, your rating and reviews.
George works for drivers too. Say "go offline" when you are done.
Drive. Deliver. Earn on your own terms. Fetch Gen San Driver.
Drive. Deliver. Earn on your own terms. Welcome to Fetch Gen San.
